library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

mpox <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(mpox))

I selected the number of measles cases in England by month

measles <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
ggplot (measles)
ggplot (measles, aes(
x = date,
y = metric_value
)) +
geom_line(colour = "red")+
xlab("Date")+ 
ylab("Number of Cases")+
ggtitle("Number of measles cases")
